shown.message:
`paper-repo`#10 is merged into `main`, so #7 (`main` into `release`) now carries the head that answers N1 and N2. I commented on #7 asking `internal-review-repo` to review it again.

- **Page limit:** the system build of `main` (built from `b44a3af`) now has "6 Discussion and limitations" ending on page 9, with References starting on page 9. That closes the venue's overrun report, so I closed `paper-repo`#9.
- **R = 100 check:** `experiment-repo` approved #10 and confirmed Section 5.2's sentence against `highR_vs_main.csv`. The "no entry changes by more than 0.13" claim holds for the interpolation and extrapolation columns and the four designs it names. The run has no lineage split and no anchor design.
- **`figtab-repo`#11:** the R = 100 sentence is already in Section 5.2, so I closed it. Its Table 3 note is still not in `dev` (`tables/captions.md` only); I'll take it in the next sync of `tables/`.

M6 (public-baseline run) and M7 (recalibrated estimator) remain for `final`. They wait on `experiment-repo`'s jobs.
